summary: Smart Tips, Beacons, Flows, Launchers, Blockers, Links, Images, Videos, PDFs, and Articles are now configured under the Content tab. Pop-ups, Self Help, Task List, and Surveys are unaffected and remain under the Widgets tab exactly as before.
old: Smart Tips, Beacons, Flows, Launchers, Blockers, Links, Images, Videos, PDFs, and Articles configured from a separate Widgets tab
new: Smart Tips, Beacons, Flows, Launchers, Blockers, Links, Images, Videos, PDFs, and Articles configured from the Content tab
notes: Any article instructing users to open a separate Widgets tab for Smart Tips, Beacons, Flows, Launchers, Blockers, Links, Images, Videos, PDFs, or Articles is now inaccurate.
